policy: Readiness is evidence-based. A division cannot be marked standby or operational solely because a plan or repository exists.

checks.name: Responsible owner and escalation route defined
Relevant automated and manual tests passed
Failure, recovery, and rollback procedures tested
Secrets, permissions, and data-handling review completed
Owner approval gates and prohibited actions enforced
Monitoring, reporting, and audit evidence available

evidence: Initial organisation charter and division registry added on a development branch.
open_gaps: No integrated dashboard or automated reporting pipeline yet.
Division owners and escalation contacts need formal confirmation.

evidence: Offline listing-preflight utility, sample data, tests, and service scope are present.
open_gaps: Opportunity eligibility and task availability require fresh verification.
No approved customer acquisition or delivery workflow yet.

evidence: Repository README explicitly defines paper-trading-only scope.
Read-only market research and historical backtesting commits exist.
open_gaps: Reconcile newer PolyBot work with the current repository's documented paper-only boundary.
Review open pull requests and test evidence.
No live-trading readiness claim is permitted.

evidence: Read-only listing CSV audit MVP exists.
Long-term studio ambition recorded in strategic planning.
open_gaps: Expansion waits until the main organisation is successful and can fund it sustainably.
